## [1.13.1-dev.4](https://github.com/PrathxmOp/Prathxm-Patches/compare/v1.13.1-dev.3...v1.13.1-dev.4) (2026-08-24)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Chess.com:** resolve local analysis crashes and move classification accuracy ([#35](https://github.com/PrathxmOp/Prathxm-Patches/issues/35), [#37](https://github.com/PrathxmOp/Prathxm-Patches/issues/37), [#51](https://github.com/PrathxmOp/Prathxm-Patches/issues/51)) ([5ebe4f0](https://github.com/PrathxmOp/Prathxm-Patches/commit/5ebe4f055581234096a05039bb973e8eddc6a837))

patches.name: Clone Chess.com
patches.description: Changes the package name to com.chess.prathxm, allowing the patched app to be installed side-by-side with the original Chess.com app.

patches.name: Custom Titles
patches.description: Fetches and applies custom titles for users from a remote database. DM PrathxmOp to get yours for fun lol!

patches.name: Global Crash Handler
patches.description: Catches uncaught exceptions and displays a custom crash screen with details to report issues.

patches.name: Lichess Puzzles
patches.description: Loads daily puzzles from Lichess and bypasses Chess.com puzzle premium limits.

patches.name: Local Stockfish Analysis
patches.description: Enables local Stockfish engine for post-game review & analysis.

patches.name: Unlock All Bots
patches.description: Unlocks all premium and restricted bots in the Versus Bots feature.
